project.name: ZETA GCI + Collections
project.description: Micro SaaS for solo Philippine real estate agents: BIR-compliant commission & VAT engine, developer receivables/collections tracking, and GCI goal planning.

discovery.targetUsers: Individual Philippine real estate brokers and salespersons (solo practitioners) self-logging commissions on developer, resale, rental, and referral deals. v2: teams/brokerages.

storyMap.title: Receivable entity + auto-create/restate from deal events
Collections math: payments aggregation, balance, dates, idle/aging
Status lifecycle, Confirmed Collectible override, variance & write-off
Ledger UI, detail view, downstream projections & hardening
Aging, receivables by developer, Data Health
Chase list + inline Next Action + performance hardening
Reports UI: five tabs, toggle, year selector, reading guide
Exports, print layout, performance & cache hardening
Contextual help placements & empty states across modules

techRequirements: Relational database (PostgreSQL-class) — FKs, sequences (permanent D001… deal codes), append-only audit log, soft-delete
Server-side pure calculation engine (computeDeal, computePaymentSplit) — the only code path producing money figures; UI never computes money
Exact decimal arithmetic end to end (DB numeric + decimal library); binary floats forbidden in money paths; round half-up to centavos only at persistence/display; ₱0.50 comparison tolerance
Multi-tenant, single-user tenants v1; membership schema team-ready for v2; friction-gating (confirmations + audit) instead of roles
Event-driven read models restated on deal/payment events; monolith-first; background jobs for bulk recompute and import
₱ #,##0.00 formatting; Asia/Manila workspace time (store UTC); mobile-first at 360px for M5 fast-entry and M6 chase list
CSV/XLSX export on every table; one-time v30.x workbook importer (MVP scope, acquisition wedge)

Acceptance anchor: imported workbook must reproduce Total Collectible ₱6,763,497.25 / Collected ₱1,908,192.86 / Outstanding ₱4,855,304.39; D021 NET GCI ₱354,591.84; fixture N1 for non-VAT workspaces — all to the centavo, server-side
